newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas unit makes Dutch investment.
newsitem.headline: Paribas unit makes Dutch investment.

text.p: Paribas's Paribas Deelnemingen affiliate bought 25 percent of Dutch holding company Vegro Beheer from Sequoia Participatiemaatschappij NV for an undisclosed amount, Paribas said on Tuesday in a statement.
Sequoia is an investment unit of Fortis and Paribas Deelnemingen is the Dutch unit of Cobepa, a 65 percent-controlled unit of Paribas.
Vegro Beheer is the holding company of Dutch heating equipment wholesaler Groothandel Vegro.
Vegro Beheer had 1995 sales of 1.02 billion francs and net profit of 37 million francs.
Nederlansde Participatiemaatschappij NV and SHV Distributie Nederland NV control the balance of the capital of Vegro Beheer.
